description: Fix memory leak in WebSocket handler at /home/ga/workspace/memory-leak-project/src/websocket-handler.js. The file registers event listeners (message, error) on WebSocket connections that are never removed, causing memory to grow over time. There is also a setInterval (stored in variable pingInterval) that creates a timer but never clears it. Add proper cleanup in the 'close' event handler: (1) use .removeAllListeners('message') and .removeAllListeners('error') to remove the listeners, (2) call clearInterval(pingInterval) to stop the timer, (3) ensure this.connections.delete(connectionId) is called. The close handler already has the delete call but is missing the listener and interval cleanup. Save the file when done.
